result.topic_en: Differential formulas giving the change in computed heliocentric longitude and latitude of a planet at opposition with respect to changes in the orbital elements, with a worked numerical example for the 1807 opposition of Pallas.
result.transcription:
49.
Differentialformeln bei Berechnung der Oppositionen

$\lambda$ ber. hel. Länge | $r$ Radius Vector | $n$ Tage seit Epoche
$\lambda'$ beob. hel. Länge | $a$ halbe große Axe | $\tau$ tägliche Bewegung
$\omega$ Sonnennähe | $i$ Neigung der Bahn
$v$ wahre Anomalie | $\Omega$ Knoten
$E$ excentrische Anomalie | $b$ heliocentrische Breite
$e=\sin\phi$ Excentricität | $\beta$ geocentrische Breite

$\frac{\sin 2(\lambda-\Omega)}{\sin 2(v+\omega-\Omega)}=A$, $\frac{Aaa\cos\phi}{rr}=B$, $\frac{Aaa\sin E(2-ee-e\cos E)}{rr}=C$ {+$A\sin v(1+\frac{p}{r})$+}

$\partial\lambda = B.\partial Ep. + nB.\partial\tau + (A-B)\partial\omega + C.\partial\phi + (1-A)\partial\Omega - \frac{1}{2}\tang i\sin 2(\lambda-\Omega)\partial i$ {+$\sin o$[?] $- \tang b\cos(\lambda-\Omega)$+}

$\frac{\sin\beta\sin(\beta-b)}{\sin b}=D$, $\sin\beta\cos(\beta-b)\cos b=E$, $\frac{Da\tang\phi\sin v}{r}=F$
$\frac{Da\cos\phi\cos v}{r}=G$

$\partial\beta = -F.\partial Ep. + \left(\frac{2D}{3\tau}-nF\right)\partial\tau + F\partial\omega + G\partial\phi - \frac{E}{tg(\lambda'-\Omega)}\partial\Omega + \frac{E}{\sin i\cos i}\partial i$

Beispiel. Opposition der Pallas von 1807.
